Author: rude
Name: JobBar
Description: Displays registered gearsets on custom movable bars with drag-and-drop job and role-group assignment.
Changelog: Adds user-created named bars with drag-and-drop assignment for individual jobs and complete role groups. Existing layouts migrate automatically.

Author: rude
Name: Player Compass
Description: Draws a dot at the local player's exact world position with N, S, E, and W labels projected onto the ground around the player.
Punchline: Shows your hitbox point and world directions around your character.
Changelog: Initial release with a player hitbox dot, world direction labels, customization, and an out-of-combat visibility option.

Author: rude
Name: Pothead
Description: Starts a 30-minute countdown when either North Horn pot FATE spawns and shows which pot FATE is expected next.
Punchline: Tracks North Horn pot FATE rotations.
Changelog: Adds the GitHub repository link to the installed plugin metadata.

Author: rude
Name: Hotbar Labels
Description: Displays configurable per-job PvE and PvP keybind text on native hotbar slots without changing the game's actual keybindings.
Punchline: Per-job cosmetic keybind labels for hotbar slots.
Changelog: Adds separate per-job PvE and PvP profiles for cosmetic labels and hotbar visibility, with automatic mode switching and migration of existing settings to PvE.

Author: rude
Name: HUD Nudge
Description: Shows a compact directional pad while editing the HUD layout and moves the selected HUD element one pixel per click.
Punchline: One-pixel nudge buttons for the HUD Layout editor.
Changelog: Initial release with one-pixel directional controls and absolute X/Y positioning.

Author: rude
Name: Positional Labels
Description: Draws an F or R badge over hotbar actions that currently require a flank or rear positional, including dynamically changing combo actions.
Punchline: Shows flank and rear markers on positional hotbar actions.
Changelog: Fix positional markers for dynamically adjusted Viper actions and clear them during Third and Fourth Generation swaps.

Author: rude
Name: RudeUI
Description: Replaces the player and target frames with compact, configurable unit frames styled to match the native FFXIV HUD.
Punchline: Native-styled player, target, and cast bars.
Changelog: Adds native UI mouseover publishing for MOAction's default UI Mouseover target source.

Author: rude
Name: Viper HUD
Description: Shows Viper's current combo action, mandatory follow-ups, positionals, buffs, and job gauges in a compact movable HUD.
Punchline: A readable replacement-aware combat HUD for Viper.
Changelog: Initial release with replacement and mini gauge modes, combo and positional guidance, follow-up indicators, and configurable Coil/Den availability lines.

Author: rude
Name: Burst Timers
Description: Shows single two-minute timers for Dokumori on your target and Embolden, Starry Muse, Brotherhood, and Searing Light on you, plus your actual combat potion cooldown. Configure with /bursttimers.
Punchline: Cooldown and active-duration bars for party buffs, Dokumori, and potions.
Changelog: Adds independently movable active-duration bars for Dokumori, party buffs, and the stat-potion effect, with live refresh and expiration.

Author: Rude
Name: Furniture Veil
Punchline: Hide and replace that gpose furniture that's too small for you
Description: Hide and replace that gpose furniture that's too small for you
Changelog: Initial experimental release: hide and restore individual placed furnishings during GPose, with search, a selection marker, and copyable coordinates. Live rendering validation is pending.
